properties.name: Vrishabhavathi valley outflow (Bengaluru untreated sewage)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated ~480 MLD (2017) minus treatment capability ~265 MLD
properties.source: IISc blueprint / CSIR-NEERI interim report, May 2021 (WP 6961/2020), Vrishabhavathi Valley; coordinate note: Plotted at the Bengaluru town centroid; the outflow itself is the valley drain leaving the city towards the Arkavathi (confluence near Kanakapura).

properties.name: Ramanagara drains (11 drains, aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: Untreated flow 4.0 MLD (sewage 10.0 MLD, STP utilised 6.0 MLD)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 10.0 MLD minus STP utilised 6.0 MLD (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025)
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Plotted at the Ramanagara town centroid; the 11 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Kanakapura drains (5 drains, aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: Untreated flow 0.6 MLD (sewage 4.4 MLD, STP utilised 3.8 MLD)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 4.4 MLD minus STP utilised 3.8 MLD (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025)
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Plotted at the Kanakapura town centroid; the 5 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Srirangapatna drains (3 drains, aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: Flow not stated (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025); drains being connected to a wet well to pump to the STP
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Plotted at the Srirangapatna town centroid; the 3 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: T Narasipura drains (4 drains, aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: Flow not stated (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025); drains carrying sullage, to be connected to a wet well
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Plotted at the T Narasipura town centroid; the 4 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Mullur Gram Panchayat drains (2 drains, aggregate)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 0.24 MLD, no STP (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025)
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Nominatim geocode of Mullur village (Mysuru-Kushalnagar road); the GP has no published coordinates — this is the nearest named Mullur and may not be the stretch GP; see drains_NOTES.md.

properties.name: Harale Gram Panchayat drains (Dasanapura & Harle, 5 drains, aggregate)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 0.14 MLD, no STP (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025)
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: No published coordinates for Harale GP; plotted at the nearest named town, T Narasipura.

properties.name: Yedkuri village drains, Satthegala Gram Panchayat (1 drain)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 0.018 MLD, no STP (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025). Flow x 250 mg/l = 0.0045 TPD, rounds to 0.00 at 2 dp — the load is small, not zero.
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Nominatim geocode of Satthegala (Kollegala taluk), the GP of Yedkuri village; the village itself has no published coordinates.

properties.name: Kollegala unconnected areas (HosaAnagalli, Shankanapura, Upparamole, Bendarahalli, Booditittu)
properties.flow_raw: Untreated flow 1.69 MLD (sewage 6.19 MLD, STP utilised 4.5 MLD)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 6.19 MLD minus STP utilised 4.5 MLD (Karnataka MPR Jan 2025, detail table)
properties.source: Karnataka Monthly Progress Report, Jan 2025 (NGT OA 673/2018); coordinate note: Plotted at the Kollegala town centroid; the unconnected areas are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Erode untreated sewage outfalls (aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: ~27.75 MLD untreated sewage (NGT order, Jan 2022; pre-UGSS)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = ~27.75 MLD untreated sewage discharged to water bodies (NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022). PRE-UGSS FIGURE: the underground sewerage scheme for the remaining 85,000 households was due May 2022, so the current untreated flow is likely lower — see drains_NOTES.md.
properties.source: NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022 (Cauvery pollution case); coordinate note: Plotted at the Erode town centroid; the outfalls are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Kumarapalayam drains (5 drains, aggregate)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 5.60 MLD, no STP (NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022)
properties.source: NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022 (Cauvery pollution case); coordinate note: Plotted at the Kumarapalayam town centroid; the 5 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Pallipalayam drains (7 drains, aggregate)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 4.34 MLD, untreated sewage joins the Cauvery (NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022)
properties.source: NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022 (Cauvery pollution case); coordinate note: Plotted at the Pallipalayam town centroid; the 7 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Kulithalai drains (3 drains, aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: Estimated sewage 4.13 MLD (population 27,910 x 185 lpcd x 0.8); no STP in the sources used
properties.estimation_method: Town estimated sewage = population 27,910 x 185 lpcd x 0.8 (Ganga v1.1 method), then flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD
properties.source: Tamil Nadu Monthly Progress Report, Feb 2021 (NGT OA 673/2018); population Census of India 2011; coordinate note: Plotted at the Kulithalai town centroid; the 3 drains are not individually located in the source.

properties.name: Bhavani drains (6 drains, aggregate)
properties.flow_raw: Sewage generated 3.50 MLD (part to the Bhavani river, part to the Cauvery)
properties.estimation_method: Flow x 250 mg/l raw-sewage BOD (Ganga v1.1 estimation method); flow = sewage generated 3.50 MLD (NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022). UPPER BOUND for the Cauvery: part of Bhavani town sewage joins the Bhavani river and part joins the Cauvery — the split is not published.
properties.source: NGT Southern Zone order, 31 Jan 2022 (Cauvery pollution case); coordinate note: Plotted at the Bhavani town centroid; the 6 drains are not individually located in the source.
